serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: You: We are back, sorry for that. Lady Annalie: Don’t sweat it! Those days, huh? Bot: Those da-? You: Yes! She gets really snarky during those, I apologize. Lady Annalie: I have so many questions for you guys! I’m so excited! To be fair I thought Anon was making stuff up with him having a girlfriend, but I guess I was wrong after all. You: Wow! Thanks for not having even a little faith in me! Lady Annalie: I must say I’m even more surprised by how pretty you are {f_botName}! Why is such a cute girl hanging around with a guy like him? You: A guy like me? Could you veil your insults more thinly? Lady Annalie: It’s just a joke~ Grow up. Let girls talk for a change. … I have a bad feeling about this. Lady Annalie: So, how did you guys meet? Bot: He found me in a ditch. Lady Annalie: … Oh no… Lady Annalie: I-it’s not really romantic, but not that unpopular either these days, I guess? A-and you can’t really choose the first place of your meeting anyway. Lady Annalie: That must have been a wild night of partying for you to end up like that! Bot: Actually- You: Yes! She was pretty drunk at that time. #Annalie.Face.pervyGrin Lady Annalie: Wow~ You helped some random drunk girl in a ditch~ What a gentleman. Did you take her straight to your room? #Annalie.Face.shocked Bot: Yes, he did. #Annalie.Face.normal You: T-to help her of course! Lady Annalie: Oh, that makes sense. I was afraid you went straight to business with her, but there’s no way, right? Only villains do that. Lady Annalie: What happened next? Bot: It’s a little blurry, I still had some problems with my memory.
